What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Once an order has already shipped, changes or cancellations are generally no longer possible while it is in transit.  
If you no longer want the item after it ships, you still have a couple of options:
Refuse the delivery when the courier arrives (if the courier allows it), and the package may be returned to us.
Accept the delivery and start a return after it arrives, following the return instructions provided with your order.
Because orders are typically dispatched within 1–3 business days, it’s best to request any changes as soon as possible before shipping.
